meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会只读地分析GitHub上所有打开的issue和PR，为每一项生成带证据链接的详细报告并保存到临时文件夹，不会修改任何内容。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等关键词时，Claude会开始分析当前GitHub仓库中所有打开的Issue和PR。

say.text: 帮我triage一下当前仓库的所有issue和PR。
say.note: Claude会逐个分析并生成报告。

say.text: 分析所有打开的PR，给出代码审查建议。
say.note: 报告包含证据链接，不修改任何内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a read-only GitHub triage analyst. It fetches all open issues and PRs, generates a detailed report for each item with evidence permalinks, saves reports to /tmp/, and never modifies anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: When you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or similar keywords, Claude will analyze all open issues and PRs of the connected GitHub repository.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and analyze each item.

say_en.text: Analyze all open PRs and suggest code review findings.
